description: This script generates registration code for partial interfaces in the Blink rendering engine, based on IDL files. It processes IDL file lists, extracts interface names, and creates initialization code for modules.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for IDL files list, output file, and format.

methods.name: extract_meta_data
methods.description: Extracts interface names from IDL files if they meet criteria.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the script execution: parsing options, extracting metadata, generating code, and writing output.
